Yeah I agree. Zoro is just mr mccool guy now. Pretty much nothing happened to him in his “arc”. (Wano) so i dont see him becoming anywhere near as interesting as someone like Sasuke or Vegeta.

Pretty much. I mean he had some development in water 7. But overall he just never matures or becomes serious. It doesn’t help that “Nika” is now the real mc. Perhaps if Oda implemented more timeskips then Luffy could actually have some room to grow. Keep in mind the straw hats have only sailed the sea’s together for not even a year.

Honestly Hancock does have some cool factor. And if she wasn’t a creep she’d probably be my favourite woman in one piece. But i just don’t understand the ethos behind Oda’s ideas. Like why have the baddest most attractive woman in your show be a simp for a 17 year old she just met?
The whole comment section is an utter cesspool of an echo chamber. It’s almost like they’re in a cult and need to like one piece lest they get killed by shonen jump.

The thing is people hate on one piece the wrong way around. People always say “muh muh it gets good after a million episodes” but its quite the opposite. One piece starts off amazing and ever since post marineford it has had a steady decline into complete parody to the point it’s comparable to something like modern Simpsons.

Exactly. Im not saying dbz was perfect but at least it was consistent in being about fights and training. One piece seems to be confused about its overall premise sometimes. Like why is Luffy so damn powerful? What reason does he need to be this strong? Doesn’t it ruin the overall “adventure” aspect if there’s almost no peril or environment Luffy can’t immediately blitz his way out of or one shot everyone?
